name: submit_scientific_action_v3
description: Submit one closed scientific-action proposal for trusted Python authorization. This tool does not authorize or calculate.

analysis_class.description: The analysis the user requests, or NONE if no single listed analysis class fits the objective.

operation.description: The registered operation that implements analysis_class for the number of referenced observations, or NONE. dynamislm:registered-operation:duration-normalized-distance@1.0.0: External-load duration-normalized distance. Implements no listed analysis_class. dynamislm:registered-operation:longitudinal-absolute-change-v1@1.0.0: RES-69 absolute change. Implements SCALAR_ABSOLUTE_CHANGE with exactly 2 observations. dynamislm:registered-operation:longitudinal-within-athlete-sample-sd-v1@1.0.0: RES-69 descriptive within-athlete sample SD. Implements no listed analysis_class. dynamislm:registered-operation:unit-normalization@1.0.0: External-load unit normalization. Implements no listed analysis_class.

observation_ids.description: Ids of the request observations the analysis uses.

target_claims.description: Only the claim levels the user explicitly requests. Do not add lower levels a requested level presupposes.
